name: Filled Vessel
summary: At Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage gathers sacred waters for Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus. The Filled Vessel carries samples from Teldrassil’s moonwells to aid his study of the World Tree’s ailments.

sections.title: A Confluence of Sacred Waters
sections.body: Night elf acolytes gather water from moonwells across Teldrassil. The tree was planted without the blessings of the Great Aspects, Alexstrasza and Nozdormu, leaving its boughs open to corruption, strange beasts, and crazed furbolg tribes. Corithras Moonrage gathers the phials in Dolanaar and pours them into the Filled Vessel for the journey to the capital. Together, the waters offer a vital sample of Teldrassil’s vitality. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm studies them in the Cenarion Enclave, seeking a remedy for the Great Tree’s flaws.

faq.q: What is inside the Filled Vessel?
faq.answer: The Filled Vessel holds water gathered from several moonwells across Teldrassil. Corithras Moonrage combines the phials in Dolanaar.

aliases: who do I give the filled vessel to
faq.answer: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm needs the Filled Vessel. He resides atop the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why does Fandral Staghelm need these water samples?
faq.answer: Teldrassil’s afflictions stem from its lack of the Great Aspects’ blessings. Strange corruption, aggressive wildlife, and mad furbolgs plague its branches, and Staghelm studies the mingled waters to understand the tree’s flaws and seek a remedy.
Corithras Moonrage prepares the vessel in Dolanaar, pouring in the phials gathered by young adventurers before sending it to Darnassus.

angles.text: As a druid serving the Cenarion cause, delivering this vessel is your first official errand to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm. It shows you how fragile Teldrassil’s living world remains.
As a night elf, you know the moonwell waters as sacred lifelines of your people’s new home. They mingle Elune’s magic with the uncertain growth of the unblessed World Tree.
